entry.value: import knime.scripting.io as knio%%00010import re%%00010import datetime as dt%%00010import requests%%00010import pandas as pd%%00010import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET%%00010%%00010# ------------------- SETTINGS -------------------%%00010TALLY_URL = "http://localhost:9000"%%00010COMPANY = "Your Company Name" # exactly as shown in Tally%%00010BOOKS_FROM = "20250401" # company "Books beginning from" date (YYYYMMDD)%%00010FROM_DATE = "20250401" # period start = start of the period shown in Tally's report%%00010TO_DATE = "20260331" # period end%%00010DEBUG = False # True = print a sample voucher's XML%%00010# ------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010LEDGER_TAGS = ("ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST", "LEDGERENTRIES.LIST")%%00010INV_TAGS = ("ALLINVENTORYENTRIES.LIST", "INVENTORYENTRIES.LIST",%%00010 "INVENTORYENTRIESIN.LIST", "INVENTORYENTRIESOUT.LIST")%%00010%%00010# Voucher types that do not post to the books%%00010NON_POSTING = {"purchase order", "sales order", "delivery note", "receipt note",%%00010 "rejections in", "rejections out", "stock journal", "physical stock",%%00010 "memorandum", "reversing journal", "job work in order",%%00010 "job work out order", "material in", "material out"}%%00010%%00010%%00010def tally_post(xml, timeout=300):%%00010 try:%%00010 r = requests.post(TALLY_URL, data=xml.encode("utf-8"), timeout=timeout)%%00010 r.raise_for_status()%%00010 except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:%%00010 raise RuntimeError(%%00010 f"Could not reach Tally at {TALLY_URL}. Check that TallyPrime is open, "%%00010 f"the company is loaded and the server is enabled. Details: {e}")%%00010 # Tally emits illegal XML control characters, so strip them%%00010 text = re.sub(r"&#(?:[0-8]|1[1-2]|1[4-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1]);", "", r.text)%%00010 text = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]", "", text)%%00010 try:%%00010 return ET.fromstring(text), r.text%%00010 except ET.ParseError as e:%%00010 print(r.text[:3000])%%00010 raise RuntimeError(f"Tally response is not valid XML: {e}")%%00010%%00010%%00010def collection_request(coll_name, obj_type, fetch, from_date, to_date):%%00010 return f"""%%00010<ENVELOPE>%%00010 <HEADER>%%00010 <VERSION>1</VERSION>%%00010 <TALLYREQUEST>Export</TALLYREQUEST>%%00010 <TYPE>Collection</TYPE>%%00010 <ID>{coll_name}</ID>%%00010 </HEADER>%%00010 <BODY>%%00010 <DESC>%%00010 <STATICVARIABLES>%%00010 <SVEXPORTFORMAT>$$SysName:XML</SVEXPORTFORMAT>%%00010 </STATICVARIABLES>%%00010 <TDL>%%00010 <TDLMESSAGE>%%00010 <COLLECTION NAME="{coll_name}" ISMODIFY="No">%%00010 <TYPE>{obj_type}</TYPE>%%00010 <FETCH>{fetch}</FETCH>%%00010 </COLLECTION>%%00010 </TDLMESSAGE>%%00010 </TDL>%%00010 </DESC>%%00010 </BODY>%%00010</ENVELOPE>"""%%00010%%00010%%00010def dr_pos(s):%%00010 """Tally amount -> float with Debit = positive, Credit = negative.%%00010 Handles '12,75,907.67 Dr', '... Cr', or Tally's raw sign (debit = negative)."""%%00010 if s is None or not s.strip():%%00010 return 0.0%%00010 t = s.strip().replace(",", "")%%00010 try:%%00010 if t.lower().endswith("dr"):%%00010 return abs(float(t[:-2].strip()))%%00010 if t.lower().endswith("cr"):%%00010 return -abs(float(t[:-2].strip()))%%00010 return -float(t)%%00010 except ValueError:%%00010 return 0.0%%00010%%00010%%00010def plain(s):%%00010 """Plain signed number from a stock value such as '1275907.67' or '12,75,907.67'."""%%00010 if s is None:%%00010 return 0.0%%00010 t = re.sub(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", s.replace(",", ""))%%00010 try:%%00010 return float(t)%%00010 except ValueError:%%00010 return 0.0%%00010%%00010%%00010def r2(x):%%00010 return round(x, 2) + 0.0 # + 0.0 removes negative zero%%00010%%00010%%00010def yes(s):%%00010 return (s or "").strip().lower() == "yes"%%00010%%00010%%00010def is_pl(name):%%00010 return name.lower().replace(" ", "") == "profit&lossa/c"%%00010%%00010%%00010# ---------- 1. Ledger master: group, books-beginning opening, Tally's closing ----------%%00010led_root, _ = tally_post(collection_request(%%00010 "KNLedgerColl", "Ledger", "Name, Parent, OpeningBalance, ClosingBalance",%%00010 BOOKS_FROM, TO_DATE))%%00010%%00010ledgers = {}%%00010for el in led_root.iter("LEDGER"):%%00010 name = el.get("NAME") or el.findtext("NAME") or el.findtext("NAME.LIST/NAME")%%00010 if not name:%%00010 continue%%00010 ledgers[name.strip()] = {%%00010 "Parent": (el.findtext("PARENT") or "").strip(),%%00010 "BookOpening": dr_pos(el.findtext("OPENINGBALANCE")),%%00010 "TallyClosing": dr_pos(el.findtext("CLOSINGBALANCE")),%%00010 }%%00010%%00010if not ledgers:%%00010 raise RuntimeError("No ledgers returned. Check the company name and that it is open in Tally.")%%00010%%00010# ---------- 2. Voucher types -> base type (to skip non-posting vouchers) ----------%%00010base_of = {}%%00010try:%%00010 vt_root, _ = tally_post(collection_request(%%00010 "KNVchTypeColl", "Voucher Type", "Name, Parent", BOOKS_FROM, TO_DATE))%%00010 for el in vt_root.iter("VOUCHERTYPE"):%%00010 nm = (el.get("NAME") or el.findtext("NAME") or "").strip()%%00010 if nm:%%00010 base_of[nm.lower()] = ((el.findtext("PARENT") or "").strip() or nm).lower()%%00010except RuntimeError:%%00010 print("Voucher type list not available; using voucher type names only.")%%00010%%00010# ---------- 3. Vouchers ----------%%00010vch_fetch = ("Date, VoucherTypeName, VoucherNumber, IsCancelled, IsOptional, IsPostDated, "%%00010 "AllLedgerEntries.*, LedgerEntries.*, "%%00010 "AllInventoryEntries.*, InventoryEntries.*")%%00010vch_root, _ = tally_post(collection_request(%%00010 "KNVoucherColl", "Voucher", vch_fetch, BOOKS_FROM, TO_DATE))%%00010%%00010if DEBUG:%%00010 v0 = vch_root.find(".//VOUCHER")%%00010 if v0 is not None:%%00010 print(ET.tostring(v0, encoding="unicode")[:4000])%%00010%%00010%%00010def entries_of(v):%%00010 """Return [(ledger_name, amount_string)] for the accounting lines of a voucher,%%00010 without counting the same line twice."""%%00010 led = []%%00010 for tag in LEDGER_TAGS: # prefer ALL... list, else the plain list%%00010 found = [c for c in v if c.tag == tag]%%00010 if found:%%00010 led = [((c.findtext("LEDGERNAME") or "").strip(), c.findtext("AMOUNT"))%%00010 for c in found]%%00010 break%%00010 # If the ledger lines balance on their own they are complete (the invoice's%%00010 # item-level allocations then repeat the same Sales/Purchase amounts).%%00010 if led and abs(sum(dr_pos(a) for _, a in led)) < 0.01:%%00010 return led%%00010 have = {n for n, _ in led}%%00010 extra = []%%00010 for child in v:%%00010 if child.tag in INV_TAGS:%%00010 for alloc in child.findall("ACCOUNTINGALLOCATIONS.LIST"):%%00010 n = (alloc.findtext("LEDGERNAME") or "").strip()%%00010 if n and n not in have:%%00010 extra.append((n, alloc.findtext("AMOUNT")))%%00010 return led + extra%%00010%%00010%%00010pre_dr, pre_cr = {}, {} # movement before FROM_DATE -> goes into opening%%00010per_dr, per_cr = {}, {} # movement within the period%%00010lines = [] # every posted line, for diagnostics%%00010skipped = {}%%00010vch_count = 0%%00010%%00010for v in vch_root.iter("VOUCHER"):%%00010 if yes(v.findtext("ISCANCELLED")) or yes(v.findtext("ISOPTIONAL")) \%%00010 or yes(v.findtext("ISPOSTDATED")):%%00010 continue%%00010 d = (v.findtext("DATE") or "").strip()%%00010 if not d or d > TO_DATE:%%00010 continue%%00010 vtype = (v.findtext("VOUCHERTYPENAME") or v.get("VCHTYPE") or "").strip()%%00010 base = base_of.get(vtype.lower(), vtype.lower())%%00010 if base in NON_POSTING:%%00010 skipped[vtype] = skipped.get(vtype, 0) + 1%%00010 continue%%00010 vno = (v.findtext("VOUCHERNUMBER") or "").strip()%%00010 vch_count += 1%%00010 in_period = d >= FROM_DATE%%00010 for lname, amt in entries_of(v):%%00010 if not lname:%%00010 continue%%00010 a = dr_pos(amt) # Debit positive, Credit negative%%00010 if a == 0:%%00010 continue%%00010 lines.append((d, vtype, vno, lname, a))%%00010 dr_map, cr_map = (per_dr, per_cr) if in_period else (pre_dr, pre_cr)%%00010 if a > 0:%%00010 dr_map[lname] = dr_map.get(lname, 0.0) + a%%00010 else:%%00010 cr_map[lname] = cr_map.get(lname, 0.0) + (-a)%%00010%%00010unknown = (set(per_dr) | set(per_cr) | set(pre_dr) | set(pre_cr)) - set(ledgers)%%00010if unknown:%%00010 print("WARNING: voucher ledgers not found in the ledger master:", sorted(unknown))%%00010%%00010# ---------- 4. Opening Stock (from stock items, not a ledger) ----------%%00010stock_fetch = "Name, Parent, OpeningBalance, OpeningValue, ClosingBalance, ClosingValue"%%00010if FROM_DATE <= BOOKS_FROM:%%00010 st_root, _ = tally_post(collection_request(%%00010 "KNStockColl", "StockItem", stock_fetch, BOOKS_FROM, TO_DATE))%%00010 stock_tag = "OPENINGVALUE"%%00010else:%%00010 prev_day = (dt.datetime.strptime(FROM_DATE, "%Y%m%d")%%00010 - dt.timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y%m%d")%%00010 st_root, _ = tally_post(collection_request(%%00010 "KNStockColl", "StockItem", stock_fetch, BOOKS_FROM, prev_day))%%00010 stock_tag = "CLOSINGVALUE"%%00010%%00010opening_stock = abs(sum(plain(si.findtext(stock_tag)) for si in st_root.iter("STOCKITEM")))%%00010if opening_stock == 0:%%00010 print("NOTE: Opening Stock came out as 0. Check that your stock items have values "%%00010 "and the dates are right.")%%00010%%00010%%00010# ---------- 5. Build the trial balance ----------%%00010def make_row(name, parent, op_net, tr_dr, tr_cr, tally_cl=None, check=True, note=""):%%00010 cl_net = op_net + tr_dr - tr_cr%%00010 return {%%00010 "Ledger": name,%%00010 "Parent": parent,%%00010 "Opening_Debit": r2(max(op_net, 0.0)),%%00010 "Opening_Credit": r2(max(-op_net, 0.0)),%%00010 "Debit": r2(tr_dr),%%00010 "Credit": r2(tr_cr),%%00010 "Closing_Debit": r2(max(cl_net, 0.0)),%%00010 "Closing_Credit": r2(max(-cl_net, 0.0)),%%00010 "Opening_Net": r2(op_net),%%00010 "Closing_Net": r2(cl_net),%%00010 "Tally_Closing_Net": r2(tally_cl) if tally_cl is not None else None,%%00010 # 0 = closing matches Tally's own closing for this ledger%%00010 "Check_Diff": r2(cl_net - tally_cl) if (check and tally_cl is not None) else None,%%00010 "Note": note,%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010rows = []%%00010pl_name, pl_info = None, None%%00010for lname, info in ledgers.items():%%00010 if is_pl(lname):%%00010 pl_name, pl_info = lname, info # handled below%%00010 continue%%00010 opening_net = info["BookOpening"] + pre_dr.get(lname, 0.0) - pre_cr.get(lname, 0.0)%%00010 rows.append(make_row(lname, info["Parent"], opening_net,%%00010 per_dr.get(lname, 0.0), per_cr.get(lname, 0.0),%%00010 tally_cl=info["TallyClosing"]))%%00010%%00010rows.append(make_row("Opening Stock", "Opening Stock", opening_stock, 0.0, 0.0,%%00010 check=False, note="From stock items (not a ledger)"))%%00010%%00010# Profit & Loss A/c in the Trial Balance is the brought-forward balance: nothing posts%%00010# to it, so it is the figure that balances everything else in the opening column.%%00010pl_open = -sum(r["Opening_Net"] for r in rows)%%00010rows.append(make_row(pl_name or "Profit & Loss A/c", "Primary", pl_open, 0.0, 0.0,%%00010 tally_cl=pl_info["TallyClosing"] if pl_info else None, check=False,%%00010 note="Brought-forward balance (balancing figure). Tally's ledger "%%00010 "closing includes the current period result."))%%00010%%00010df = pd.DataFrame(rows)%%00010first = df[df["Ledger"] == "Opening Stock"]%%00010rest = df[df["Ledger"] != "Opening Stock"].sort_values(["Parent", "Ledger"])%%00010df = pd.concat([first, rest]).reset_index(drop=True)%%00010%%00010# ---------- 6. Summary and diagnostics ----------%%00010print(f"Ledgers: {len(ledgers)} | Vouchers used: {vch_count} | Opening Stock: {opening_stock:,.2f}")%%00010if skipped:%%00010 print("Skipped non-posting vouchers:", skipped)%%00010print(f"Sum Opening_Net (should be 0): {df['Opening_Net'].sum():.2f}")%%00010print(f"Sum Closing_Net (should be 0): {df['Closing_Net'].sum():.2f}")%%00010print(f"Closing Debit total {df['Closing_Debit'].sum():,.2f} | "%%00010 f"Closing Credit total {df['Closing_Credit'].sum():,.2f}")%%00010%%00010bad = df[df["Check_Diff"].notna() & (df["Check_Diff"].abs() > 0.01)]%%00010print(f"Ledgers with Check_Diff != 0: {len(bad)}")%%00010for _, r in bad.iterrows():%%00010 diff = abs(r["Check_Diff"])%%00010 hits = [x for x in lines if x[3] == r["Ledger"] and abs(abs(x[4]) - diff) < 0.01]%%00010 print(f" {r['Ledger']}: Check_Diff = {r['Check_Diff']:,.2f}")%%00010 if hits:%%00010 print(" voucher line(s) with exactly this amount (date, type, no, ledger, amount):")%%00010 for x in hits[:10]:%%00010 print(" ", x)%%00010 else:%%00010 print(" no single voucher line equals this difference")%%00010%%00010knio.output_tables[0] = knio.Table.from_pandas(df)
